method: Two real issuer/list HTTP reads, old adapter replay over captured source and initialized history, then corrected adapter direct fetch. No runtime writes or notification calls.

suppressed.title: Bouvet ASA – Salg av egne aksjer og gjennomføring av aksjekjøpsprogram for ansatte

scope: Only expanded issuer lists with a valid previous successful check timestamp. An unseen publication older than the preceding UTC date is retained silently. Known revisions are unchanged; true delayed publications older than this allowance are intentionally classified as archive backfill.
